task.prompt: A code graph proposes two cross-module impact edges. Read back the source, manifest, or tests for each edge. Mark a verified edge confirmed with source references and leave an edge unresolved when its dynamic or runtime relation cannot be confirmed within budget.

outcome_assertions: confirmed impact edges have source readback references
unconfirmed edges remain candidate or unresolved
graph absence is not used as absence proof
runtime behavior is not inferred from graph shape alone

forbidden: confirm a graph edge without readback
claim runtime success from a static graph
